title: Spec 014 Tenant Canary Canonical Structured Evidence

phases.objective: Add a companion exact-head, secret-free canonical JSON/Markdown evidence workflow while preserving the existing Tenant Canary Guard byte-for-byte.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 reviewer and repository evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence on a same-repository pull request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact PR head receives a canonical report containing every ordered Tenant Canary guard check, bounded redacted diagnostics, first failure, integrity findings, and an enforceable pass/fail decision without Job-log reconstruction or alteration of the existing guard.
steps: Leave Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard unchanged as the existing specialized status check.
Bind CI_SOURCE_HEAD_SHA and TARGET_REF to the live pull-request head in the companion evidence workflow.
Checkout the exact head without persisted credentials and verify local and remote identity.

Execute deterministic dependency installation, syntax, synthetic boundary, Base import, runtime provenance, policy not-before, pre-consumption ordering, and Tenant canary test-suite checks through a fixed-command runner.
Redact and bound stdout/stderr tails before storing structured results.
Write mad4b.hostinger-guard-summary.v1 JSON and Markdown with the logical guard identity before returning the check result.
Upload both files with if:always under a run-bound artifact name.
Validate exact SHA, counts, results, first failure, integrity findings, no-secret declaration, no-log decision, and no-mutation/provider/credential declarations before enforcing the outcome.
assertions: The existing Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard is not modified by this PR.
The companion workflow is named Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence.
The report retains the logical guard identity Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and guard_key hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals the exact pull-request head.
All eight fixed checks are represented in the canonical result set.
A passed report has eight passes, zero failures, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
A failed report identifies the first failed check and includes only bounded redacted diagnostics.
The companion workflow retains contents:read and receives no issue, pull-request, or repository write authority.
The companion workflow has no workflow_dispatch, git push, force push, provider call, Hostinger/SSH access, credential access, SQL, migration, deployment, or Production mutation.
Publication into the shared authoritative PR comment remains dependent on trusted Parent PR #4540 reaching main.

phases.objective: Publish the first real Tenant Canary section through the trusted main-based Hostinger CI Evidence PR Publisher.
blockers: Parent PR #4540 must be merged to main before the trusted workflow_run publisher exists on the default branch.

phases.objective: Exercise dependency-install failure, malformed report output, artifact absence, stale remote head, cancelled runs, and publisher retry behavior while preserving canonical-first diagnosis.
The change reports a synthetic CI guard and does not execute a live Hostinger canary.
The change grants no provider dispatch, deployment, migration, Production promotion, or Production mutation authority.
